blocks.tamil_translation: a human being; if I have harmed any Mu'min (believer), abused him, cursed him, or struck him, I make a covenant with You that You make all of this a mercy for that Mu'min, a means of purification from sin, and a cause of attaining nearness to You on the Day of Qiyamah. Do not go against this!” Rasulullah ﷺ made this du'a, Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ الْمُغِيْرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: لَا تَسُبُّوا اْلاَمْوَاتَ فَتُؤْذُوا اْلاَحْيَاءَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي، باب ما جاء في الشتم، رقم:١٩٨٢
blocks.tamil_translation: “Do not abuse the dead. By that, you will become ones who have harmed the living.” Hazrat Mughirah ibn Shu'bah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.text: Explanation:- That is, “By abusing the dead, distress is caused to their living relatives, while no harm of any kind comes to the dead person who is abused.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: اُذْكُرُوْا مَحَاسِنَ مَوْتَاكُمْ وَكُفُّوْا عَنْ مَسَاوِيْهِمْ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابو داؤد، باب في النهي عن سب الموتي، رقم:٤٩٠٠
blocks.tamil_translation: “Remember the good of your (Muslim) dead; do not mention their evils.” Hazrat Abdullah ibn Umar (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَة ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ مَظْلَمَةٌ لِاَخِيِهِ مِنْ عِرْضِهِ اَوْ شَيْءٍ فَلْيَتَحَلَّلْهُ مِنْهُ الْيَوْمَ قَبْلَ اَنْ
